author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಪುಟ್ಟಜಗ ನಿನದಿಹುದು ಹಿಗ್ಗಿಸದನರಿಯುತ್ತ
ದಿಟ್ಟಹೆಜ್ಜೆಯನಿಡಲು ಗೆಲುವು ಕಾದಿಹುದು
ಪಟ್ಟ ಕಷ್ಣವ ಮರೆಯೆ ದಾರಿತಪ್ಪುವೆ ಜೋಕೆ
ಗಟ್ಟಿತನವಿರಬೇಕು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Your world is small; know how to widen it;
take a bold step and victory is waiting;
beware: if you forget the hardships you went through, you will lose your way;
you need firmness, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Widen your small world with bold steps, and success awaits. But remember the hardships that shaped you, or you may lose your way. Stay firm.
